name: Liveblocks
solves: Provides managed realtime infrastructure for multiplayer apps — presence, rooms, Yjs storage, comments, and AI copilots — with React-first SDKs so teams ship collaborative features without operating WebSocket servers.
best_for: Product teams adding multiplayer presence, cursors, and collaborative state quickly
React/Next.js apps that want hosted rooms instead of self-hosting Socket.IO/Yjs providers
Editors that want Liveblocks Yjs integration without running a sync backend
Apps needing comments, notifications, and multiplayer UX primitives from one vendor
Startups that value time-to-multiplayer over owning realtime infrastructure
skip_when: You must self-host all realtime infrastructure with no SaaS dependency
You only need a simple chat channel — Socket.IO or a thin ws server may suffice
IoT/MQTT protocols are required rather than web multiplayer rooms
Budget cannot support a managed multiplayer platform beyond free tiers
You already operate a mature Yjs/PartyKit stack and do not want another vendor
